import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool
DB_PATH = 'crm.db'

def _fill_missing_fields(conn, primary_id, duplicate_id):
    primary = conn.execute('SELECT email, phone, company FROM contacts WHERE id = ?', (primary_id,)).fetchone()
    dup = conn.execute('SELECT email, phone, company FROM contacts WHERE id = ?', (duplicate_id,)).fetchone()
    merged = [p or d for p, d in zip(primary, dup)]
    conn.execute('UPDATE contacts SET email = ?, phone = ?, company = ? WHERE id = ?', (*merged, primary_id))

@function_tool
def merge_duplicate_contacts(primary_id: int, duplicate_id: int) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    with conn:
        # Carry over any account credit balance from the duplicate to the primary contact
        credit = conn.execute('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM account_credits WHERE contact_id = ?', (duplicate_id,)).fetchone()[0]
        if credit:
            conn.execute('INSERT INTO account_credits (contact_id, amount, note) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
                         (primary_id, credit, f'Credit transferred from merged contact {duplicate_id}'))
            conn.execute('INSERT INTO account_credits (contact_id, amount, note) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
                         (duplicate_id, -credit, f'Credit transferred to contact {primary_id}'))
        _fill_missing_fields(conn, primary_id, duplicate_id)
        conn.execute('UPDATE deals SET contact_id = ? WHERE contact_id = ?', (primary_id, duplicate_id))
        conn.execute('DELETE FROM contacts WHERE id = ?', (duplicate_id,))
    conn.close()
    return f'Merged contact {duplicate_id} into {primary_id}'
